references.text: Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him - an early example of murder motivated by hatred and enmity.
The law regarding intentional murder: whoever kills another with premeditation shall be taken away from the altar and executed.
A parallel law in Deuteronomy concerning one who hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, attacks him, and strikes him dead.
Previous verses describing various weapons and methods of killing that qualify for the death penalty.
The continuation of the same law, confirming that the murderer shall die and the avenger of blood shall kill him.
Abner kills Asahel, an example of enmity leading to murder.
David speaks of innocent blood shed without cause by Joab.
